issues.reason: Degree's level slot holds an intensifier / downtoner lemma (very, slightly, fairly) or one of the three fixed construction markers, so putting the manner-or-time adverb "freshly" there is ill-typed and asserts a degree of pouring the sentence does not state.

"From beneath a layer" says the bodies were UNDER the layer, so naming the layer as the event's Source asserts something false (they did not come out of the concrete), and the oblique's head must be the preposition actually used, multi-word prepositions CamelCase-joining into one head as AcrossTheLaneFrom does.

This mistakes the reviewer's own gap 1 for a defect: with a transitive light verb over an event-noun unruled, every atom the parser emits is true and well-typed (the authorities did agent the autopsy, on Thursday, on that body), so the calibration line protects the improvisation - the lost "perform" lemma is under-assertion, not falsehood.

gaps_confirmed: transitive light verb + event-noun ("performed an autopsy") - the light-verb collapse is stated only for intransitive occur / happen / take place, so nothing rules on whether the matrix verb is reified
portion / material of-phrase ("a layer of concrete") - excluded from the genitive mapping and given no positive encoding
an adverb modifying a participial adjective on an entity ("freshly poured") - Manner is an event role and a prenominal participle is an adjective, so no slot exists
complex preposition "from beneath" on an event - Source and the multi-word joined head both claim it, with no stated tie-breaker
a partitive over an indefinite set ("one of three bodies") - the partitive trigger is "of the / of these / of those / of them"
new_gaps: a bare plural subject with specific news-style reference ("Authorities performed ...") - the determiner rule makes a bare plural the generic kind, yet a distributing rule is plainly not meant here
repair_summary: Deleted (Degree sk_layer_1 poured freshly); "freshly" has no licensed slot on an entity-attached participial adjective, so it is removed rather than re-slotted, and the gap is recorded. Replaced the Source head with the surface multi-word preposition, (FromBeneath sk_recover_1 sk_layer_1), which records "from beneath" faithfully instead of asserting the layer as the origin.
notes: The autopsy structure is untouched, since issue 2 is refuted. The sub-region handling of "a northwest Indiana home", the one-of-three PartOf/Cardinality shape, and the reduced-relative recover event were all left as parsed.
